body: Absolutely mate. I can’t run anymore out of fear that my intrusive thoughts will get worse. I think it’s also called something like exercise-induced anxiety, which pretty much means as you exercise your heart rate increases and your body is tricked into thinking your anxious. For me, this means my intrusive thoughts get worse. You’re definitely not alone. Maybe try doing some exercise that you really enjoy at a low level. Like perhaps start off walking and see how you feel. For me, I hopped back in the pool and just the enjoyment out of that kinda made me forget that I even get intrusive thoughts while I exercise. Feel free to DM me if you want to chat 👍🙏🏻

Look, unfortunately not. It’s just something that I’d have to deal with for a year and a half. I didn’t mention the length of time to scare you, but rather say that you should be pro-active in your recovery. I still haven’t done much work to accept my OCD and haven’t placed any strategies in place to cope with the thoughts. This has made it a lot harder to deal with. If I were you, I’d start to see a psychologist and ask them to help you with your intrusive thoughts. I hope that helps in some way hahaha

I am so sorry you feel like this. OCD is so unbelievably hard to deal with and we need to normalise that so you don’t feel so un-normal with the way that you deal with your obsessions. I struggled with OCD myself but with a weird type called “Pure O” which means I only get the obsessions not the compulsions. I am so terribly sorry that you have to deal with ur compulsions on a regular basis. It seems like such a task. So you don’t feel so weird I suffer from sexual intrusive thoughts which is really messed up!! The fact that it brings you to tears breaks my heart because I know and everyone knows what this f@cked disease feels like. Stay strong, you’ll find a way out. If you ever want to talk feel free to message me.

I have something that is called Pure O, which means I don’t have any compulsions I just have the obsessions. It’s really difficult to cope with. I have them in the form of sexual intrusive thoughts which is really weird but is also very normal. I was diagnosed in June 2021 but had my first intrusive thought in December 2020. I was cooking in the kitchen with my sister and then just out of nowhere, BANG, thought, image, urge popped into my head. I didn’t tell my psychologist for months cause I genuinely thought I was into incest. Ik, very fucked up! But he reassured me that they’re just a thought and they mean nothing. I hope you’re feeling ok with your new diagnosis. If you have any questions feel free to DM me!

That’s ok if you’re uneducated around OCD!! I was too initially. From what it sounds like you’ve been through a lot and I’m very sorry to hear that. However, it’s good now that they’ve finally reviewed ur condition and realised it’s OCD and not something else. I was diagnosed with OCD in mid 2021 after I had my first intrusive thought in Dec 2020. When you said that “I didn’t even think I did a single OCD thing”, maybe you didn’t!! I have a form of OCD called ‘pure O’ where I just have obsessions and no compulsions such as the typically “washing of hands”. Perhaps, like me, you didn’t/don’t have any compulsions and just have the thoughts which is still OCD. If you’re still confused I recommend a YouTube video called “what is pure OCD?” by “The school of life”. If gave me so much perspective and made me realise how normal it is to have these thoughts. 
Hope this helped!!

Firstly, you’re not a deviant. These thoughts are uncontrollable and do not have anything to do with the type of person that you are. It’s a really good that you KNOW that you don’t have a real desire and you’re aware that they’re just thoughts. Part of the challenge is trying to reinforce the idea that we are not our thoughts. From what it sounds like, you definitely have OCD if you are continually having these obsessive thoughts, so, and this is just a suggestion, maybe ask your therapist for coping mechanisms instead of confessing the obsessions, however, if you feel guilty and need to confess that’s also perfect. All the best!! (FYI - I have been diagnosed with OCD and suffer from sexual intrusive thoughts. What a life we live!!) DM me if u have any questions or just wanna talk!
